vignette: A child with special health care needs presents as a new patient. The medical history documents a chronic condition, and the caregiver asks what preventive counseling the child will receive.
stem: Which approach to anticipatory guidance is most appropriate for this child?

options.text: Guidance that addresses concerns tied to the child's medical status, including caries, periodontal, trauma, and orthodontic risks
Guidance restricted to caries risk alone
Standard generic guidance that does not take the child's medical status into account
Guidance on periodontal and trauma risks only, leaving caries and orthodontic concerns out
